# Stanford Medicine

> Stanford Medicine integrates a world-class medical school, clinical care delivery, and cutting-edge research across MD, PhD, and master's degree programs.

Stanford Medicine serves as the academic medical center for Stanford University, offering comprehensive medical education, patient care services, and biomedical research opportunities. The institution encompasses multiple schools and programs spanning basic science, clinical training, graduate education, and continuing professional development.

## Key Topics

- MD Program
- PhD Programs
- Master's Programs
- Clinical Trials
- Biomedical Research
- Graduate Education

## Medical Education & Degree Programs

- [MD Program](https://med.stanford.edu/md.html): MD Program homepage with admissions, curriculum, and physician training.
- [PhD Programs](https://med.stanford.edu/education/phd-programs.html): PhD programs in bioengineering, biosciences, and biomedical research.
- [Master's Programs](https://med.stanford.edu/education/masters-programs.html): Master's programs in biomedical data science, epidemiology, and health policy.
- [M.S. in Physician Assistant Studies](https://med.stanford.edu/pa.html): Master's program in Physician Assistant Studies with clinical training.
- [Education Overview](https://med.stanford.edu/education.html): Stanford Medicine education overview covering all degree and training programs.

## Research & Clinical Trials

- [Research](https://med.stanford.edu/research.html): Stanford Medicine research overview including translational and clinical trials.
- [Clinical Trials Portal](https://med.stanford.edu/clinicaltrials): Stanford Medicine clinical trials portal with volunteer recruitment and registries.
- [Funding Opportunities](https://med.stanford.edu/rmg/funding): RMG funding opportunities and grant writing resources for researchers.
- [Research Centers and Programs](https://med.stanford.edu/school/directory/research-centers-and-programs.html): School of Medicine directory of research centers and academic programs.
- [Researcher Resources](https://med.stanford.edu/school/directory/researcher-resources.html): School directory of researcher resources and support services.

## Healthcare Services & Clinical Care

- [Health Care Services](https://med.stanford.edu/health-care.html): Stanford Medicine healthcare services overview for patient care delivery.

## School Directory & Faculty

- [School Directory](https://med.stanford.edu/school/directory.html): Official School of Medicine directory for departments, labs, and resources.
- [Basic Science Departments](https://med.stanford.edu/school/directory/basic-science-departments.html): School of Medicine directory for basic science departments and programs.
- [Clinical Science Departments](https://med.stanford.edu/school/directory/clinical-science-departments.html): School of Medicine directory for clinical science departments and training.
- [CAP Faculty Profiles](https://med.stanford.edu/profiles): CAP faculty profiles and research publication database for Stanford Medicine.

## Professional Development & Continuing Education

- [Continuing Medical Education](https://med.stanford.edu/cme): CME center providing continuing education for healthcare professionals.
- [Summer Outreach Programs](https://med.stanford.edu/education/summer-outreach.html): Summer outreach programs for high school and undergraduate students.

## Main Portal

- [Stanford Medicine Home](https://med.stanford.edu): Stanford Medicine homepage integrating medical school, hospitals, and research.
